members.name: description
members.doc: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

members.name: errorMessage
members.doc: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

members.name: value
members.doc: The submitted value, when the caller controls it. The input shows a matching item's label.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting value, when the field controls itself.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new value each time the text changes or a suggestion is chosen. A chosen suggestion reports its value, not its label.

members.name: onSelect
members.doc: Called when a suggestion is chosen, with the chosen item.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: size
members.doc: The control size. The suggestion list takes it too.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the field read-only: its text stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed, and no suggestion can be chosen.

members.name: required
members.doc: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

members.name: invalid
members.doc: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the field invalid.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named field submits the chosen suggestion's value, or the typed text when nothing was chosen.

members.name: items
members.doc: The suggestions, as strings or records. A string is shown and submitted as its text. Typing filters them by their text.

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: An example value shown while the field is empty. It does not name the field.

types.name: AutocompleteItem

members.name: id
members.doc: Identifies the suggestion. Without one, a record takes its value, or else its position, as one.

members.name: label
members.doc: What the list and the input show. Without one, a record shows its value, or else its id.

members.name: value
members.doc: What the form and onChange receive when the suggestion is chosen. Without one, a record submits its id, or, with no id either, its label's text.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Skips the suggestion in selection.
